question: Does a development-selected complete configuration improve practical W1 strength against the accepted full Construction choices at10+0.1?

null.admission: Both null development stages pass their frozen .55 selection rules; matched-depth development-witness diagnosis is complete with no unresolved correctness/lifecycle violation. Do not substitute null alone after observing confirmation.

removal.admission: removal-clock-v2 passes every integrity/resource gate and scores at least.55. Otherwise this allocation remains unused; do not transfer it or promote another formulation into it.

identity: Each hypothesis compares candidate/full in the SAME frozen runtime, with CP64 SHA2568431626c2fca81e0a1e9ccd5e45ddd8829e6e3282c756c21fad75b06d075bb2b. Build73 null-family and build71 removal identities remain distinct; no cross-runtime performance claim or outcome pooling. No evaluator, TT-policy or production-default change. Runner seed is selection seed plus1-based block ordinal.
samplingAssumptions: Both uncertainty calculations assume the sampled opening pairs provide representative independent outcomes in this fixed domain. Neither calculation resolves systematic opening-family, persistent process-state or clock effects; unique held-out openings and color reversal mitigate rather than prove absence of bias.
openings: Fresh unique paired/color-reversed eight-full-move openings from the recorded source book, partition1. Exclude every available tracked historical selection receipt, all current frozen selections (played or unplayed) and development-corpus-prefix exclusions. Select/split all admitted samples before any independent game, no evaluator filter, fixed seeds, exact source/selector/split hashes. No development or historical confirmation game is reused.

analysis.primary: One final opening-pair mean after all128 complete pairs. Pair scores are the mean of their two color-reversed game scores; sample variance with n-1 denominator and standard error sqrt(variance/n). Two-sided97.5% normal-approximation interval uses z=NormalDist.inv_cdf(1-.025/2). Primary positive support requires its score lower bound strictly greater than.5 and all integrity/resource gates. Report assumptions and uncertainty; approximate normal validity is not an exact finite-sample guarantee.
analysis.sensitivity: Also report bounded-pair Hoeffding97.5% interval with half-width sqrt(log(2/.025)/(2*128)). If it crosses.5, explicitly state that conservative sensitivity does not independently establish superiority; do not hide it behind the primary result. Report W/D/L, pentanomial counts, pair scores and logistic Elo transforms as conditional descriptive estimates.
analysis.dispositions: Primary lower>.5: positive under the stated primary assumptions, recommendation may be considered without automatic promotion. Primary upper<.5: negative under those assumptions. Otherwise inconclusive. Zero pair variance or missing primary interval is inconclusive unless separately reported bounded evidence supports a conclusion; do not invent a normal interval.
analysis.multiplicity: At most these two pre-selected hypotheses, each alpha.025; unused allocation is not transferred. No further finalist, alternate formulation, sample extension or outcome-driven reallocation in this confirmation plan.

execution: Four fixed32-pair blocks per admitted hypothesis, fresh engine processes and200k-node startup warmup per block, same frozen inputs, one serial W1 game. Existing validated adapters, strict normal legal/history outcomes, whole-request accounting, Windows owned Job containment and descendant drain. BelowNormal, Xms256m/Xmx512m, ActiveProcessorCount4. Expected about2h15 per hypothesis including qualification from observed development durations;90min watchdog per block. No build/test/computational overlap. This is low-disruption serial research, not a continuous12h disruptive run.
resources: Before each block: passing identical actual-profile owner-thread calibration ending within15min, or a fresh prospective repeat; then idle30s otherCPU<=2.0 and memory>=8GiB/load<=75%. After each block: whole-owned-run same global/memory gates after nativeCPU subtraction; actual-profile owner-thread delivery medians>=.90, nearest-rank fifth percentiles>=.80, median spread<=.05; per-actor nativeCPU/Search-elapsed .90..1.25 and absolute difference<=.10. Native CPU includes startup/JIT/GC. These practical checks do not establish perfect isolation or bound every burst. Do not change numerical gates after outcomes.
stopping: No interim score inspection, outcome-based stopping, tuning, extension or game exclusion. Block reports expose only integrity/resources until all four complete. Stop affected confirmation on integrity/correctness/resource failure or owner interruption and preserve every completed/partial game. Never replay a started block, discard/replace an unqualified block or treat incomplete confirmation as the planned128-pair result. A failed prelaunch admission may be revisited with identical inputs in a later window at least15min later; completed qualified blocks may resume only with verified unchanged evidence and no unclosed block. No automatic production promotion or successor CGLHW.
